subject: general
question: If 22% of a number is equal to (4)/(9) th of another number, what is the ratio to the second number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equate the percentages and fractions directly: 22% × **First Number** = 4/9 × **Second Number**.

22/100 × A = 4/9 × B ⇒ 11/50 × A = 4/9 × B.

Ratio A : B = (4 × 50) : (11 × 9) = 200 : 99.

**∴ The correct answer is 200:99.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 22% of **First Number** (x) = 4/9 of **Second Number** (y).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9a9f6764af16372ee59a66047d766ad8fe222b14c5103f02e4b681f0dd2a1b7.png] 

**Formula Used:** Ratio x : y = (Value attached to y) : (Value attached to x) when equating products.

⇒ 22% × x = (4/9) × y

⇒ (22/100) × x = (4/9) × y

⇒ (11/50) × x = (4/9) × y

⇒ x/y = (4/9) ÷ (11/50)

⇒ x/y = (4/9) × (50/11)

⇒ x/y = 200/99

**∴ The correct answer is 200:99.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert x% to a fraction, divide by 100. Example: 22% = 22/100 = 11/50.

Ratio and Proportion Property

If Ax = By, then the ratio x : y is B : A. This is used to solve **equated quantities** efficiently.</p
